Privacy

This site has no accounts for visitors, no advertising and no third-party trackers.

Visits

The site counts page views so I can see what gets read. Each view records the page, the site you came from, the time, and a random number that lasts until you close the tab. It doesn’t use cookies, and it doesn’t record your IP address or anything that identifies you. If your browser sends a Do Not Track signal, nothing is counted.

Messages

When you use the contact form, your name, email address and message are stored so I can read and answer them. Email hey@leobattiste.com to have a message deleted.

Saved links

Links you save in the Toolbox are stored in your browser’s local storage and never leave it. Exporting creates a file on your device, and importing reads that file in your browser.

Appearance

Your light or dark theme choice is saved in your browser.

Hosting

Content, messages and view counts are stored with Supabase. The hosting service may process technical information needed to deliver the site, such as network requests. External websites have their own privacy practices.
